projects.title: Tody.app
projects.description:
A Flutter task manager focused on fast daily capture, clean task states, and simple editing flows.
Built with Appwrite authentication and cloud storage so users can manage personal tasks across sessions.
The UI keeps the common actions close: create, update, complete, and review without extra screens.

projects.title: Convertix
projects.description:
An offline Android file-conversion utility where files stay on the device instead of being uploaded.
Current flows include PDF to JPG, image to JPG, and ZIP creation.
The product direction is privacy-first document tooling with simple local processing.

experiences.description: Developed and maintained cross-platform Flutter applications, contributed to the migration from FlutterFlow/Firebase to a scalable Flutter, Express.js, and MongoDB architecture, built responsive UI and Admin Panel features, integrated REST APIs, and implemented state management using Provider, BLoC, and Cubit.
